findings.text: follow-on: the new "The revision you record" section is unreachable — reckon/crew/review.py:241 load_review_prompt has no caller anywhere in reckon/ — so no reviewer reads this file; the ask that actually reaches a reviewer is only the dispatch done_when, and the node's measure names the prompt as one of its two delivered halves.

follow-on: a record carrying reviewed_base_sha or reviewed_head_sha with a null value reaches the row as the key set to null rather than omitted, so a promoted row can name a revision that is not a sha; carried_revision_pair preserves the key by design but no case covers the null value.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base — 0841bff48 asks the brief and the prompt for the pair, 91d959b0e carries the pair onto the promoted row's block, 0297bc0ac is the docs-only landing record.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure names the brief ask, the prompt ask and the row block; tests/test_a_promoted_row_names_its_reviewed_revision.py asserts all three, and the manifest records the two gate arms (428 passed at fa66c530, 433 passed at 91d959b0e, zero added) and the declared mutation reddening the row case.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a promoted ledger row names the revision its review read; the composed brief asks the reviewer to record the pair (reckon/crew/recovery.py:472, _review_dispatch_fields) and the row now carries it (reckon/crew/review.py:1513 ledger_block through carried_revision_pair).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records base fa66c530 arm 428 passed/0 failed (EXIT=0) and head 91d959b0e 433 passed/0 failed (EXIT=0), the negative control at 2 failed/3 passed (EXIT=1), and it honestly reports the review prompt's inertness as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: `git diff --stat fa66c530..0297bc0ac` lists exactly the five declared paths — reckon/crew/recovery.py, reckon/crew/prompts/review.md, reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_a_promoted_row_names_its_reviewed_revision.py, docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/a-promoted-row-names-its-reviewed-revision.html — the declared docs/figures directory is unused and no plan meta line is touched.

justifications.durability: the row, legacy-spelling and bare-block cases fail under the declared mutation (negative control 2 failed, 3 passed), but tests/test_a_promoted_row_names_its_reviewed_revision.py:66,75 are substring-presence checks on the brief and prompt text.
justifications.evidence: the base and head arms and the mutation receipt are on disk with exit lines, the derivations are reproduced by hand-with positive controls, and the derivation instrument sees synthetic and absent failures before any zero is reported.
justifications.fit: ledger_block reuses carried_revision_pair and the module idiom, the added lines pass the naming checks, and no new symbol carries a plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:1554-1556 writes the canonical pair onto the row block and the row case round-trips a stored record to it, but the prompt half never reaches a reviewer because reckon/crew/review.py:241 load_review_prompt has no caller in reckon/.
